Revision (major only), 
Document Title, 
Document Type,

the associated AR ID,

The system shall automatically maintain the status of a change request:
Draft - the default state when created
In Review - the state where the change request is in review by the approvers
Approved - the state where the change request has been approved by all reviewers
Implementation - the state where the change request has pending Implementation Task(s)
Closed - the state when an approved change request has been fully implemented by doc control

The system shall automatically update the status attribute of all documents/parts on the change order when the state of the change order changes:
Pending Change when the AR is in Draft State
In Review when the AR is in In Review State
Approved when the AR is in Approved State 
Approved when the AR is in Implementation State
Released when the AR is in Closed State

The system shall use of secure, computer-generated, time-stamped audit trails to independently record the date and time of operator entries and actions that create, modify, or delete electronic records.
The audit trail shall ensure that previously recorded information are not deleted or obscured and available for review through revision history
The audit trail documentation shall be retained for a period at least as long as that required for the subject electronic records.
The System shall provide the ability to produce the entire content of the record in human-readable form, including audit trails and electronic signatures.
The system shall restrict access to authorized users.
The system shall enforce unique User IDs or a similarly secure mechanism (e.g., fingerprint).
The system shall store passwords in a non-human-readable form.
The system shall prevent unauthorized access when system is left unattended for a predetermined length of time, currently set to 1 hour and 15 minutes.
The system should lock a user account when the number of consecutive failed login attempts exceeds the established limit.
The system shall provide functionality to set user access privileges.
The system shall limit user functions to their assigned privileges.

The system shall automatically generate an audit trail to independently record the modification of records and include the modification date, time, who, and the previous data value for each modified regulated record.
The system shall automatically generate an audit trail to independently record the deletion of records and include the deletion date, time, who and the data values for each deleted regulated record.
The system shall enforce required sequencing of steps or events, i.e., a draft cannot be released without an approval step.

The system shall have the ability to produce in human- readable form all information associated with the signing (including full name, date, time, and meaning (such as review, approval, responsibility, or authorship) of signature).
The system shall record the date/time when an electronic signature is executed.
The system shall include the meaning of an electronic signature when executed (e.g., verified, approved, rejected, batch release).
The system shall prevent the alteration of an electronic signature.
The system shall ensure the electronic signature is linked to the respective electronic record.
The system shall ensure the electronic signature ID for each authorized user is unique.
The system shall prevent the electronic signature ID for an authorized user from being re-assigned.
The system shall prevent the electronic signature ID from being deleted.
The system shall enable the electronic signature ID to be activated.
The system shall ensure that ID codes/passwords maintain the uniqueness of each combination such that no 2 individuals ever have the same password/code.

The system shall enforce that at least one electronic signature component is confidential and secure (e.g. password or PIN).
The system shall require 2 distinct identification components during the initial signing, for multiple continuous signing sessions.
The system shall require a confidential and secure identification component during subsequent continuous signing sessions.
The system should force passwords to be changed at a predefined interval.
The system shall provide the ability to deactivate the electronic signature ID.
The system should prevent password re-use within an established limit.
